facts.text: Vela is an operating group of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a public company listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange with 6 operating groups that provide software for over 80 vertical markets.

Vela acquires, manages, and builds mission-critical vertical market software businesses that are located throughout the world, providing vertical market software expertise, operational support, and capital to help their businesses grow organically and through acquisitions.

Damian McKay was appointed as CEO of the Vela Operating Group effective September 30, 2020. He has been with Constellation Software since 2015 when he joined with CSI's acquisition of Datamine where he was the CEO.
facts.source_title: Constellation Software Inc. Announces Changes to its Management Team | CSI Software

facts.text: Tyler O'Hagan is the CFO of Vela Software. He has been with Constellation Software since 2013 and joined Vela in 2015. Prior to joining CSI, Tyler spent six years at PwC in their Audit, and Consulting and Deals practices, and is a CPA, CA.
facts.source_title: Tyler O'Hagan - Chief Financial Officer at Vela Software

facts.text: Juniper Group is an operating group of Vela Software that was established following the acquisition of Juniper Travel Technology by Vela Software in 2014. It is currently comprised of over 1,200 employees all over the world.
Vela's geographical markets span over 100 countries, where it caters to numerous verticals by leveraging a decentralized, stand-alone business model.

Over the past 12 to 14 months, Constellation directed its efforts at helping its subsidiary businesses, which include Vela Software International Inc., navigate the transition to AI, including upskilling its development teams.
facts.source_title: Constellation Software: Vela Operating Culture & AI Risk | In Practise

facts.text: In 2024, Vela strengthened its presence in the Travel sector with the acquisition of five new companies: Dome, Hotetec, Traveltek, Alturos, and Lleego.
facts.source_title: Newsletter Q1/25 & 2024 Year in Review - Vela Software Group

facts.text: The Oil & Gas sector saw key additions in 2024 with Ikon Science and Talus Technologies.
facts.source_title: Newsletter Q1/25 & 2024 Year in Review - Vela Software Group

facts.text: Juniper Group (an operating group of Vela Software) entered into a definitive agreement to acquire a majority interest in Derbysoft Holdings Limited. Key executive team members will retain a minority stake and enter into a shareholders' agreement with Juniper Group.
facts.source_title: Constellation Software's Vela Operating Group Enters into Agreement to Acquire a majority interest in Derbysoft Holdings Limited | CSI Software

facts.text: Vela Software acquired Coreworx, a business providing engineering document management, interface management and contract management solutions for oil and gas, engineering and construction industries.
facts.source_title: Vela Software Acquires Coreworx - Vela Software Group
